headline: Gameweek 12 is the focus now, and the creators here mostly talk about injuries and transfers, not a fixed plan.

points.text: Raya is reported injured, according to one video that reacts to Gameweek 11 and looks ahead to Gameweek 12.
points.label: reported

points.text: João Pedro is reported out, according to one video ahead of Gameweek 11.
points.label: reported

points.text: One creator says selling Haaland soon might be a crazy move. Treat this as one person's take, not a rule.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Several videos discuss whether to take a transfer now or wait. Most stress keeping transfers simple and planned.
points.label: opinion

points.text: For a 15-minute weekly window, check injury news first, then make one planned change at most.
points.label: ai interpretation

differences.text: Some videos push selling key players, while others lean toward holding or saving transfers. The advice is not consistent.
